F_RFAcademy.name: Rex Fleet Academy
F_RFAcademy.summary: Training institution for pilots, technicians, mechanics, navigators, statesmen, and junior officers. Academy culture teaches doctrine through practical cases rather than rote certainty.

F_CoreCivil.name: Core Civil Administration
F_CoreCivil.summary: Civilian institutions that coordinate transit, markets, public records, infrastructure, and interworld services across the Core alongside Crown and Fleet systems.

F_FleetLogistics.name: Fleet and Civil Corridor Logistics
F_FleetLogistics.summary: Interlocking military and civilian routing professionals who keep certified corridors, contingency links, convoys, maintenance traffic, and emergency movement functioning.
